Resolves #19692

Content-sized rows now measure only cells that the DOM already shows as their vdom describes them: the same content, as HTML or as text, at the same width, read from the vnode of the row's last landed update. A row that a silent pass recycled while the view's update waited for other rows' flights is skipped. It is read once its own update lands, instead of taking the height of the text it showed before. The private `#isShown` in `grid.View` holds the check, and `measureRowHeights` collects only cells that pass it.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium repro on the #19666 example, plus unit specs with a vnode-backed read stub) → L2 required (AC-1 is a unit spec, AC-2 suite-level). No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: grid unit specs skip in CI (`NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI`). Exact-head receipt at `9ee0733a44`: `test/playwright/unit/grid/WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs`, 19 passed. It includes "a row whose vdom runs ahead of the DOM is read once its update lands" (another record), "a cell whose new width has not landed is read at that width once it does", both "a note switching from html/text to the other mode with the same bytes is read once its update lands", and "the string renderer's escaped text counts as shown". |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the `WrapTextMeasure` and `AnchorCorrection` e2e run in the engine e2e job. Outside-CI: their unit halves, plus the full unit suite at `9ee0733a44` (5045 passed, 2 skipped). |

## Deltas from ticket
- The fence also compares the width, not only the text: a pending column resize lags the DOM through the same deferral. It has its own unit test.
- The fence compares within the content mode: identical bytes render differently as HTML and as text. Under the string renderer it compares against the escaped form that renderer keeps in the vnode.

## Test Evidence
- **Repro** (the #19666 example, not on `dev`): jump to row 99996, then four rapid ArrowDowns at 1400×900. Without the fence, the final row ended at a stale 100px (its text needs 81px) in 18 of 20 headless runs. With the fence, it ended at 81px in 20 of 20.
- **Mutations:**
  - with the whole fence removed, the record test fails (65 vs 40: record 1's note read for record 152);
  - with only the text clause removed, the same test fails;
  - with only the width clause removed, the width test fails;
  - with the mode-blind comparison restored, both mode-switch tests and the escape test fail;
  - with only the escape handling removed, only the escape test fails.
- agent-preflight is not hosted here; the baseline CI jobs run.

## Post-Merge Validation
- None: the integrated check on the example is #19666's own AC.
